title: Photo Walk Scratchbook
user: Photographers trying to make deliberate pictures with a real camera who want a tactile, offline prompt-and-annotation companion rather than automatic image enhancement.
smallest_useful_product: An offline tablet PWA with a short photo-walk prompt deck, a local-import contact sheet, stylus crop/line annotations, and an exportable one-page session sheet.
success_measure: In a four-week pilot, 60% of users complete three walks and mark at least one chosen image with an intentional framing or exposure note before importing it into a full editor.
constraints: Keep images and handwriting on device by default; do not claim calibrated color or RAW support; support stylus, touch, keyboard, and reduced-motion access.
